summary.text: Shannon DeLoach is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 121, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Shelley Yuhas (R) is also on the ballot and there is no incumbent.
He won the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary, defeating incumbent Michael Rivers, with 53.7% of the vote.
